items.t: eHealth (EHTH) Stock Fair Value Falls As Analysts Weigh Early Progress And Capital Risks
items.sum: eHealth’s internal fair value estimate has been revised lower, moving from US$1.81 to US$1.58 per share. Analysts link this cut to mixed views on the Lifetime Advisory Model, early feedback from the latest Annual Enrollment Period and uncertainty tied to the US$419m convertible preferred that becomes redeemable next April. As you read on, you will see how these shifting targets fit into the broade

items.t: Medicare Annual Enrollment Halftime Report: 75% of enrollees have used AI tools to review 2027 Medicare plans
items.sum: With this year's Medicare's Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) past the halfway point, new eHealth (Nasdaq: EHTH) research reveals growing use of artificial intelligence (AI) to compare options, which includes many Medicare Advantage plans that now include coverage of a GLP-1 drug to treat obesity, when qualifying conditions are met.
